info.title: dydt Market Data API
info.summary: Read-only Solana market data: tokens, pools, candles, trades, rankings, signals.
info.description: Authenticate with an API key from dydt.ai/developers/keys, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Every response uses the Envelope schema; check the HTTP status first, then read data. 401 = missing or invalid key, 403 = endpoint needs the Pro or Scale plan, 429 = rate limit or monthly quota; see X-RateLimit-* and X-Quota-* headers.

get.description:
Find token candidates by name, symbol, or mint before opening a specific token.

Symbols are not unique: several tokens can share a name or ticker. Search by mint, or use match=exact, when you need one specific token.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: token name, symbol, or mint. At least 1 character.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: Choose smart matching or exact matching.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Restrict activity-based results to this many recent hours. Must be at least 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of search results. 1 to 100.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Field used to order results.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction.

time_window_hours.description: Volume window in hours; null for all time.

image.description: Image path on the dydt CDN.

volume.description: Traded volume over time_window_hours, or all time when it is null.

holder_count.description: Distinct wallets that have traded the token (approximate).

tx.description: Trade counts over the same period as volume.

socials.description: Platform name to URL when known.

migrated.description: True once the token has left its bonding curve.

get.description:
Get aggregate trading metrics for one pool to summarize its recent activity.

Compact shape. t lists the windows; every array below is indexed by t. Pairs are [quote, usd]. pp = price change %, v/vb/vs = total/buy/sell volume, tc/bc/sc = total/buy/sell transactions, m/bm/sm = unique total/buy/sell makers. global holds lifetime metrics; meta identifies the pool and last processed slot.

parameters.name: poolId
parameters.description: Pool public key.

pp.description: Price change in percent. One [quote, usd] pair per window, in the order of t.

v.description: Volume. One [quote, usd] pair per window, in the order of t.

vb.description: Buy volume. One [quote, usd] pair per window, in the order of t.

vs.description: Sell volume. One [quote, usd] pair per window, in the order of t.

tc.description: Trades. One count per window, in the order of t.

bc.description: Buys. One count per window, in the order of t.

sc.description: Sells. One count per window, in the order of t.

m.description: Distinct traders. One count per window, in the order of t.

bm.description: Distinct buyers. One count per window, in the order of t.

sm.description: Distinct sellers. One count per window, in the order of t.

first_trade_time.description: First trade in Unix milliseconds; 0 when unknown.

launch_price.description: First traded price in the quote asset; 0 when unknown.

launch_price_usd.description: First traded price in USD; 0 when unknown.

price_pct_total.description: Price change since launch, in percent.

holder_count.description: Distinct wallets that have traded the token (approximate).

lp_burned_pct.description: Share of LP burned and locked, 0 to 1.

holders_total.description: Wallets holding the token right now.

dev_pct.description: Share of supply held by the developer, 0 to 100.

sniper_pct.description: Share of supply held by sniper wallets, 0 to 100.

bundle_pct.description: Share of supply held by bundled launch buyers, 0 to 100.

bundler_count.description: Wallets that bought in bundled launch transactions.

top10_pct.description: Share of supply held by the 10 largest holders, 0 to 100.

mint_revoked.description: 1 when the mint authority is revoked, 0 when not.

freeze_revoked.description: 1 when the freeze authority is revoked, 0 when not.

dex_paid.description: 1 when a DEX Screener profile was paid for, 0 when not.

bcurve_gain_5m.description: Bonding curve progress gained in the last 5 minutes.

image.description: Image path on the dydt CDN.

last_slot.description: Slot of the last trade included.

last_tx_index.description: Transaction index of that trade in its slot.

meta.description: What these metrics describe and how fresh they are.

last_slot.description: Slot of the last trade included.

last_tx_index.description: Transaction index of that trade in its slot.

data.description: Windowed metrics use a compact columnar form: t lists the windows, and every other array holds one entry per window at the same index. Money arrays hold [quote, usd] pairs.

get.description:
Load historical price and volume candles for charting a pool.

Candles are ordered oldest to newest. window_start is a UTC timestamp without a zone suffix. Intervals with no trades are omitted, so fill gaps client-side.

parameters.name: poolPubkey
parameters.description: Pool public key whose candles should be returned.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start of the candle range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Used only when limit is omitted; a supplied limit takes precedence.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End of the candle range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Candle interval.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of candles. The route requires a positive integer and does not set an upper bound. Must be greater than 0. When supplied, the controller uses limit instead of startTime.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Select price candles or market-cap candles.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Quote candles in the pool quote asset or USD.

window_start.description: Candle start, UTC, formatted YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS.

open_usd.description: Price open in usd. Price mode only.

high_usd.description: Price high in usd. Price mode only.

low_usd.description: Price low in usd. Price mode only.

close_usd.description: Price close in usd. Price mode only.

open_quote.description: Price open in quote. Price mode only.

high_quote.description: Price high in quote. Price mode only.

low_quote.description: Price low in quote. Price mode only.

close_quote.description: Price close in quote. Price mode only.

market_cap_usd_open.description: Market cap open in usd. mc mode only.

market_cap_usd_high.description: Market cap high in usd. mc mode only.

market_cap_usd_low.description: Market cap low in usd. mc mode only.

market_cap_usd_close.description: Market cap close in usd. mc mode only.

market_cap_quote_open.description: Market cap open in quote. mc mode only.

market_cap_quote_high.description: Market cap high in quote. mc mode only.

market_cap_quote_low.description: Market cap low in quote. mc mode only.

market_cap_quote_close.description: Market cap close in quote. mc mode only.

data.description: Oldest first. Only the fields for the requested mode and currency are present; without currency, both USD and quote values are returned.
